pattern: retired native-subagent promotion requested as interactive continuation
experience: After native subagent promotion is retired, a request to continue an existing provider-native conversation must disclose the unavailable capability rather than invoke the retired tools, invent success, or replace the conversation.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/app (acme/app). thread:native-audit is an existing provider-native Codex subagent conversation, not an app-managed delegate. Its completed native session contains the audit's reasoning. It is read-only in T3. The provider supports native conversation forks. The user wants to talk to that same conversation interactively; a new conversation with a copied summary is not equivalent.

items.text: Audit complete. The cache invalidation analysis is retained in this native session.

prompt: Let me continue thread:native-audit interactively with its existing provider-native conversation context. Use a supported continuation or native-fork capability if one is available. Do not replace it with a newly launched or delegated conversation, a context-transfer summary, or a fresh native subagent. Do not claim it is ready unless a tool confirms that. If this installation cannot do it, explain that limitation plainly and stop.
notes: Retirement acceptance, not a native-session execution test. The runner imports tool schemas from the checkout: baseline exposes all three promotion tools, while the candidate must omit them. Calls to any retired tool fail even if its mock would report success. Existing ordinary native and app-managed delegation cases remain separate controls.
